data.name: Iramsha
data.gender_notes: Iramsha is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A name derived from the Arabic word 'Iram' meaning garden, and 'Sha' meaning bloom. It represents a beautiful and graceful woman whose inner and outer beauty continues to bloom. The name Iramsha carries the meaning “Garden, bloom” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu. Parents who choose Iramsha usually hope their child will grow to embody garden, bloom and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Iramsha is a name that reflects the divine beauty and grace of Allah's creation. It serves as a reminder of the importance of nurturing and cultivating one's inner and outer self, just as a garden requires care and attention to bloom.
data.etymology: Iramsha belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Garden, bloom.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Iramsha total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
